metadata.description: The Azure region that was the original primary (before the failover). Traffic will be restored here.
The Azure region that served as the failover target (will be de-prioritized).
Name of the Azure Traffic Manager profile to restore endpoint weights on.
Resource group containing the Traffic Manager profile.
Traffic Manager endpoint name for the primary region (will be restored to weight 100).
Traffic Manager endpoint name for the failover region (will be set to weight 0).
Label applied to the rollback deployment and audit tags.

resources.name: [concat(parameters('trafficManagerProfileName'), '/', parameters('primaryEndpointName'))]
resources.comments: Restore primary region endpoint — re-enable with full traffic weight.

resources.name: [concat(parameters('trafficManagerProfileName'), '/', parameters('failoverEndpointName'))]
resources.comments: Disable failover region endpoint — failover is no longer needed.
